rows.en:
I went to see Mr. Wakatsuki.
He said there was something bothering him and asked me to come along, and then he took me to that restroom.{p}

"Sir, did the exorcism fail, by any chance?"
When I asked, he started taking off his jacket and said something like this:
"Perfect timing.
I was just wondering how I was going to get you to come here."
I had no idea at all what he was talking about.
I just watched him without a word.
Once he was naked from the waist up, he said to me:{p}

"You're right. The exorcism failed that time..."
I was so shocked I couldn't even make a sound.
"...I guess amateurs really shouldn't mess with this kind of thing.
That damn stain latched onto me, happy as could be."
With that, he spun around to face me.{p}

"Aagh!"
There was a face stuck to his stomach.
To be exact, a stain shaped like a human face...
It wore a vulgar, leering grin.
It was the total opposite of the teacher's own ghastly, desperate face, and that made it horribly creepy.{p}

He crept closer to me, little by little, and grabbed my arm tight.
So tight it hurt.
My legs froze, and I couldn't move a muscle.
And he said:{p}

"Ever since... ever since this stain stuck itself to my body... I've been strangely hungry...
No matter how much I eat, it's never enough.
No, my stomach does get full.
It's more that... my heart isn't satisfied... I never feel like I've eaten at all.
This thing is the cause.
This thing is the one that's hungry..."
With that, he grinned.{p}

"Eek..."
I let out a little scream.
He brought his face close to mine and grinned.
He was panting, huff, huff, like he was excited.
His warm breath hit my face, and it was disgusting.
Then, licking his lips, he said:
"...Those girls who came with you were very tasty.
I can't taste anything myself, mind you.
But I can tell.
Because this thing... this stain ate them so happily.
That day, even it ate too much.
It ate four of them at once.
It got sick and threw them back up.
Blehhh, just like that.
And out they came.
Pieces of their bodies, mashed to a pulp...
With their hair all tangled up in them.
Hee-hee-hee-hee... What a waste, huh?
And it was a feast you hardly ever get to eat...
This thing loves young girls.
Since then, I've tried feeding it all sorts of things, but it still seems to like young girls best.
I wonder how it feels about boys...
You're fat, so you look like you'd make a hearty meal..."
Cold sweat ran down my back.
Like a frog stared down by a snake, I couldn't move a muscle.
"Whenever I come into this restroom, I get my appetite.
I wonder why.
This is the place where I can eat with the most peace of mind."{p}

With that, he grabbed my head and pulled it toward the stain on his stomach.
My eyes met the stain's eyes.
The stain's eyes narrowed.
Just as if it were smiling...
At the same time, the mouth part grew bigger, as if it were opening.{p}

I braced myself.
I was going to be eaten by him... by this stain.
If it had to happen, I at least hoped it wouldn't hurt.
Just then, I thought I heard voices coming from his body.
"...Hosoda, run..."
"Run, Hosoda..."
They were faint, but I was sure that was what they were saying.
Startled, I looked at his body.{p}

Then I saw something I hadn't noticed when I looked before: there were other, smaller stains on his body.
Four of them.
They were stains with human faces, too.
Suddenly those stains began to moan.
"Ooooohhhn. Ooooohhhn."
Like that.
The moment they did, he started writhing in pain.
He covered his ears and began thrashing around, shouting, "Stop it, stop it!"
I didn't let that chance slip by.
I rushed out of the restroom and managed to get away.{p}

After that, he went on living as if nothing had happened.
Whenever he ran into me, he acted the same as he always had.
I couldn't talk to anyone about it.
About the teacher being a man-eating ghoul...
I was scared.
I thought that if I told anyone, he might turn back into what he was that day.
And while I kept quiet, Mr. Wakatsuki disappeared from the school before anyone knew it.
Officially, he was transferred.
But I don't know if that's true.
Because after he was gone, the stain in that restroom came back.
Maybe Mr. Wakatsuki got eaten by the stain too... Or am I overthinking it?
I'm praying that isn't what happened.
But I'm scared.
There's no saying that stain won't claim another victim, right?
{a}, there's no saying you won't be targeted, either.
Be careful.{p}Well, that's the end of my story. Who's next?{p}

Yoneyama, the new math teacher, could be a little unreliable, but maybe because we were close in age, I trusted that teacher the most.
When we explained what was going on, Yoneyama really listened, just as I'd expected.
And then the teacher offered to come to the restroom with us and take a look.
Of course, we happily went along.{p}

The moment Yoneyama saw the stain on the wall, a frown appeared.
The teacher probably had a sixth sense for spirits too.
"Something about this feels wrong..."
Yoneyama kept saying things like that while touching the stain.
But after a while, the teacher said something outrageous.{p}

"...All right, I'll check it out myself!"
Just like that.
I tried desperately to talk the teacher out of it.
We already knew it was dangerous, after all.
But Yoneyama wouldn't listen.
"Don't worry. I'm on night duty tonight anyway, so it's the perfect chance."{p}

As soon as I got to school, I went to the faculty room, and Yoneyama was there, just like always.
What a relief.
I'd been half afraid the teacher might have vanished during the night.
I tapped Yoneyama on the shoulder.
"How did it go?"
The instant our eyes met as the teacher turned around, I nearly screamed.
Why, you ask?{p}

Because the dark part of those eyes had turned a thick, muddy gold.
Those weren't the eyes of a living human being.
Seeing the look on my face, Yoneyama grinned.
That expression belonged to someone completely different from the Yoneyama I knew.{p}

I ran out of the faculty room in a panic.
It was almost strange that none of the other teachers around made a fuss.
...But after a while, I realized something.
It seems ordinary people can't tell there's anything wrong with Yoneyama.
In other words, the eyes only look gold when someone with a strong sixth sense sees them.
Since then, I've made sure never to be alone with Yoneyama.
Next time, try looking that teacher straight in the eye.
You seem to have a strong sixth sense, so I bet you'll see the same thing I did.
...Oh, right, about the stain on the wall.
Actually, I snuck into that restroom just once after that.
And then... I heard a voice.
A sobbing voice, coming from that stain.
If I told you it sounded like Yoneyama's voice..........would you believe me?{p}My story's over.
Who's next?{p}

Even after saying that, about an hour later Saijo apparently got bored.
"I'm going home, but if this stain isn't clean by tomorrow, you're gonna pay!
You got that?★"
She threatened the girl like that and just went on home.
Left all alone, the girl tried desperately to get rid of the stain.
This was Saijo, after all.
If she couldn't get the stain off, Saijo was sure to do something truly awful to her.{p}

Just then, she heard a voice from somewhere.
"Shall I help you...?"
It was after school, in a restroom everyone had already left.
The girl thought she was hearing things.
But the voice kept calling to her, again and again.
"Don't you hate that girl? I'll help you."
That was when she realized.{p}

It was the stain on the wall that was talking.
The face-shaped stain spoke to her.
"If only that girl were gone, you could get through school in peace... I'll help you.
All you have to do is give me a little gift..."
The sweet words swayed the girl's heart.
As things were, she could become Saijo's prey again at any moment.
Don't go thinking that's an exaggeration.
When you're the one being bullied, you really do feel like you've become 'prey' or a 'sacrifice.'
The girl finally nodded.
"What should I give you?"{p}

The moment she said it, the stain on the wall burst out laughing.
And the girl fainted.
When she came to, it was morning.
Somehow she'd gotten back to her own room and had been asleep in bed.{p}

She hurried to school, and the whole place was in an uproar.
Apparently Saijo had died late the night before.
They said someone had murdered her while she was asleep at home.
On top of that, her head had been brutally cut off, and it still hadn't been found.{p}

The girl headed for that restroom.
She had a hunch that was close to certainty.{p}

She went into the restroom and looked at the wall of the stall by the window.
And there was exactly what she had imagined.{p}

...was the spitting image of Saijo, she said.
That's what Ms. Hida told us.
The whole time she was talking, she kept her eyes lowered.
Now that I thought about it, I had a feeling there had been other stains, too.
I asked about the thing that bothered me most.
"Ms. Hida, how do you know all this?"
...Like that.{p}

Ms. Hida smiled, as if she'd been expecting that question.
"Because... I'm the girl who was being bullied."
Then what was the 'gift' the stain on the wall had talked about?
When I asked, Ms. Hida suddenly looked down.
"...You want to know, don't you?
Very well..."
And she rolled up the sleeves of her blouse.{p}

There was nothing inside the sleeves.
Only her slender wrists floated there, like separate living creatures.
The arms that should have been attached to them weren't there.
"My whole upper body, except from the neck up and from the wrists down... That was the gift it talked about."
I felt like I finally understood why Ms. Hida only ever wore long-sleeved blouses, even in midsummer.
"I don't know what that thing is.
But even without my body, I'm still alive like this... in this state."
The hair on the back of my neck seemed to stand on end.
If it had that kind of power, it was no ordinary evil spirit.
It had to be something far more powerful and evil, something monstrous.
Like... a demon, say.{p}

"...So please.
I want you to stay away from there.
I became a teacher so that I could keep watch over that restroom and make sure nothing like this ever happens again."
We nodded at Ms. Hida's words.
It wasn't a problem we could do anything about.
We promised not to use that restroom and to keep what we'd heard that day a secret, and then we went home.{p}

............Huh? You're asking if it's really okay for me to tell this here?
Yeah... Actually, there's something that's been bothering me.
A girl in my class has been missing since the day before yesterday.
On top of that, the girl who was her best friend has been coming to school in a long-sleeved cardigan since yesterday.
She said she'd caught a cold, though.
Yeah, it's probably just what you're thinking.
The girl in the cardigan is one of the girls who heard Ms. Hida's story with me.
I don't know whether there's a body under that cardigan of hers.
But maybe...
There's one more thing that's bothering me.
I wonder if the stains in that restroom have multiplied again.........{p}That's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

"...But I can't believe that thing is a good spirit.
We should exorcise it before something bad happens."{p}

In that instant, Ms. Hida's expression changed.
Her eyebrows shot up, she bit her lip, and she stared at me with bloodshot eyes.
Do you know the hannya, the Noh mask?
They say it's the face of a woman consumed by evil thoughts who has turned into a demon.
Ms. Hida's face looked just like it.
I'm not proud of it, but I'm not exactly the bravest type.
I was shaking all over.
If I hadn't been with the girls, I might have run away right then and there.{p}

But then Ms. Hida suddenly looked down.
"I see... It's a shame you don't understand."
The strange, possessed glint in her eyes had faded, too.
With her shoulders slumped, Ms. Hida looked like she'd turned back into a girl our own age.
"...If it's going to be exorcised, then at least let it be by my own hands... I want to exorcise it with all my heart, hoping it can rest in peace..."
Ms. Hida had a strong sense of justice, so I guess that's why she felt that way.
She looked at me and smiled weakly.{p}

"You seem to know a lot about spirits, Hosoda.
Will you tell me what I should do?"
Of course, I didn't know the first thing about exorcism.
But seeing how lonely she looked, I started to feel like I was doing something wrong.
"If it's something I can do..."
"Thank you."
She looked somehow relieved.
I sent the girls home first, and sat down facing her.{p}Now, what should I do?
Ask for more details about Saijo
Ask what the stain really is
"Don't you know anything at all about what happened to this Saijo?"{p}

At my question, Ms. Hida smirked.
"How should I know?
I'd be glad if she'd dropped dead in a ditch somewhere."
I was stunned.
Ms. Hida looked like a completely different person.
As if someone had flipped a switch.
When I didn't say anything, she rose unsteadily to her feet.
"The girl who was made to lick the stain... was me. Me, back when I was still a student."
As she said that, she picked up the bundle wrapped in the towel.
What came out of it was a kitchen knife that looked very sharp.
Even then, I still didn't understand what was happening.
I mean, she was a teacher.
But that same Ms. Hida pointed the knife at me.{p}

"The stain on Saijo's face was my curse.
After I licked that stain, a strange power to curse people awoke in me..."
She talked about these horrifying things in a perfectly flat voice.
She was supposed to be a teacher I knew well, but it was like meeting someone for the first time.
"Ever since, I've been cursing the people I hate.
Those I cursed fell ill or got hurt.
That's why I can't let that stain be destroyed!"{p}
But it wouldn't open.{p}

"I locked it, you little fool.
Anyone who tries to take that stain away from me, I'll kill them, whoever they are☆"
Ms. Hida's face had turned into the hannya again.
"Now, prepare yourself!"
She raised the knife high.
Ms. Hida, wearing a look that didn't seem human, came charging at me.{p}

I squeezed my eyes shut and crouched down.
Wham! A powerful impact hit my back!
That crash must have been the sound of my life ending.
I was dead.
Goodbye, Dad! Goodbye, Mom!
..................Then, with a start, I realized.
I wasn't dead at all.{p}

When I fearfully opened my eyes, in front of me was the lower half of a body in a skirt, hanging limply.
Following it upward with my eyes, I saw that the upper half had smashed through the glass of the door and was sticking out the other side.
Drip... drip... Warm blood fell onto my face.
Even when I peered at her, Ms. Hida didn't move, her eyes rolled back, her face full of resentment.
Apparently she'd cut her carotid artery on a shard of glass.{p}

Things got rough after that.
My legs gave out, so I was alone with Ms. Hida's corpse until the teacher on night duty found us.
In the end, they put it down to Ms. Hida having a nervous breakdown.
Well, she was a serious person, after all.
What happened to the stain, you ask?
Actually, it's still in the same spot.
Lately there's even a new rumor that if you go near the stain, you can hear a woman crying.
Some people say the voice sounds like Ms. Hida's.
As for me, I've had enough of being inside girls' restrooms.{p}That's the end of my story.
Now, who's next?{p}

"Ms. Hida, do you know what that stain really is?"
At my question, Ms. Hida nodded.
"Yes... Well.
I suppose I can tell you, Hosoda."{p}
The moment she said that, she pulled out what was inside the towel and raised it high.{p}
The instant I looked up at that... dully gleaming hammer, a heavy blow came down with a crack, and I passed out.{p}

When I came to, I was tied up, wrapped round and round.
It was dark all around me.
Had the sun gone down while I was unconscious?
"I see you're awake."
It was Ms. Hida's voice.{p}

Looking around from my cramped position, I saw that I was inside that girls' restroom.
Ms. Hida was gently stroking the stain on the wall as she watched me.
"The story I told you earlier isn't true.
But it isn't a complete lie, either."
What was she talking about?
Her voice was quiet, but eerie.
"Saijo wasn't really the bully. That's the name of the girl who was made to lick the stain.
The bully's real name was Hida..."
Hida★
Shocked, I looked up at her.
"I'll tell you what really happened back then.
Watching Saijo cry was so much fun that I shoved her against the stain on the wall...
And then the stain moved.
As if it were alive. It was beautiful."
Ms. Hida wasn't looking at me at all.
She seemed entranced, lost in some lovely memory.
"In an instant, the stain spread, and a huge mouth opened in the middle.
Can you believe it, Hosoda?"
Even now, as I tell you this, I bet you can't believe it.
But I could.{p}

Because right then, the stain twitched, as if it were reacting to her voice.
"Heh heh... My little one is happy too.
It seems to have taken a liking to you, Hosoda."
The stain had taken a liking to me...
I knew what that meant, and why the stain was happy.
Lying there on the floor, I tried to crawl away.
But she caught me right away.{p}

"You mustn't run away.
You're going to go join Saijo now."
So I was right.
I felt like I was about to faint.
Ms. Hida roughly pulled me to my feet and shoved me toward the stain.{p}

"Here you go... your first meal in a long time."
At the delight in Ms. Hida's voice, something in my mind snapped.
I screamed and thrashed my body back and forth.
Like a little kid throwing a tantrum and refusing.
She'd let her guard down, and she lost her balance.
And then..........{p}

Even now, I feel sick when I remember that moment.
The stain that had been about to eat me must have been waiting with its mouth wide open.
And unluckily for her, Ms. Hida fell right into it.
You can guess what happened, right?
I desperately worked the rope loose.
I was scared the stain might peel off the wall and come after me.
I was so scared, I don't even remember how I got home.
In the end, Ms. Hida was listed as missing.
I guess the stain ate its meal without leaving a single crumb.
...Is the stain still there, you ask?
Who knows. I never want to go near that place again.
But if that thing is alive, and Ms. Hida was the one bringing it food...
Then it can't have eaten anything since she disappeared.
It's either dead or weak... or maybe it's moved somewhere else, looking for food.{p}That's the end of my story.
Who's going to talk next?{p}
